hero.title: Owner-operated, practical by design.
hero.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works is a small technology services business based in South Carolina's Lowcountry, focused on understandable websites, automation, business systems, and technical problem-solving.

founder.name: Eddie Gugino
founder.title: Founder
founder.body: I bring an IT, cybersecurity, and technical-delivery background to LDW. The business is intentionally small and direct: understand the real problem, use the simplest maintainable solution, keep critical assets under the right ownership, and leave the work explainable.
founder.body2: That means security, access, recovery, documentation, and handoff are treated as ordinary delivery quality—not add-ons used to make a project sound more complicated.
founder.note: Founder photo and final biography wording require owner approval before production.

principles.title: Lowcountry roots
principles.description: Local context matters, but the work is not restricted to one geography.

principles.title: Clear ownership
principles.description: Critical business assets should live in the right owner accounts with named access and a practical recovery path.

principles.title: Technology in proportion
principles.description: Configure and integrate what already works before adding custom infrastructure.

principles.title: Work that can be explained
principles.description: Documentation, testing, tradeoffs, and handoff are part of the deliverable.

whySmall.title: A small business can still use disciplined technical practices.
whySmall.body: LDW is intentionally lean. That means avoiding invented scale, unnecessary subscriptions, and complicated systems that make sense only for a larger operation.
items: Direct communication about the actual problem
Documented decisions instead of hidden knowledge
A clear path for handoff, maintenance, or future growth

fit.title: Work where clarity, ownership, and maintainability matter.
fit.body: The strongest fit is an owner-operated business, professional practice, community organization, or growing small team with a concrete digital problem and a preference for understandable systems over unnecessary complexity.
